'''Oil on the rocks''' was a drink consumable by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that available at the [[Alien Quarter Cantina]].<ref name="Star Tours" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]],<ref name="KOTHB">{{Blog|holocron|7|Death Star timeline}}</ref> it was a favorite of the [[F series repair droid]] [[F-22-RGKx]].<ref name="Star Tours" />

*[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{1stm}} {{C|Tokyo only}}
